name: Triangula
summary: Desktop app and CLI that turns images into triangulated or polygonal art with a genetic algorithm.
description: Generates triangulated and polygonal art from images using a modified genetic algorithm, typically producing an optimal result within a couple of minutes for images under 3000px. Ships a GUI desktop app built on Wails, a Go CLI that renders SVG and PNG, and a Go API; the desktop app is 20-50x faster than the browser demo.
contains: triangulated and polygonal art generated from images
modified genetic algorithm; optimal result usually within a couple of minutes
GUI desktop app (Wails) plus a Go CLI and a Go API
options: points, mutations, variation, population, cutoff, cache, block, threads, repetitions
renders SVG; PNG export with effects
browser demo available; the desktop app is 20-50x faster
works best with images under 3000px and fewer than 3000 points
